column3: A plugin declares itself in package.json under xin.plugins.<name>; the generated catalog carries the declaration and the Worker never reads package.json
column4: dsh checks engines/peers at install; Xin is one Worker with a build, so the build is the only place code can arrive. The declaration must survive into the running isolate without a filesystem
column5: readManifest parses api/scopes/requires at generate time and fails the build on a bad value; catalog.gen.ts carries the result; src/kernel/manifest.test.ts covers defaults and rejections
column6: kept; api 1 is the frozen contract for this slice
